name: Planning Favourites for AniList
description: Reads the AniList "Planning" list of opted-in users and marks every matching series or movie in the Jellyfin library as a favourite. Can reuse the AniList login stored by the Ani-Sync plugin. Never removes favourites.
overview: Favourite anime from your AniList plan-to-watch list
